columns.rationale: Invoice identifier with null_rate 0.0 and 2330 distinct values across 45228 rows; samples such as '489434' are numeric-looking but the column is kept as VARCHAR since the samples do not prove every value is numeric.
Product code with null_rate 0.0 and 3141 distinct values; samples like '10002R' and '10123C' mix digits and letters, so it stays text and is renamed to snake_case.
Free-text product description with null_rate 0.005041 (228 nulls) and 3045 distinct values; samples show leading/trailing whitespace such as ' ANIMAL STICKERS', and nulls are retained.
Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0, but all samples and the min (-1395.0) and max (5184.0) are integral, so a cast to INTEGER is safe; negative values indicate returns or cancellations.
Derived boolean marking rows with negative quantity as return/cancellation lines; evidenced by min -1395.0 and negative samples (-1395.0, -1043.0, -1012.0) against a max of 5184.0.
Landed as VARCHAR with null_rate 0.0 and 2004 distinct values; every sample is ISO-shaped ('2009-12-01 07:45:00'), supporting a cast to TIMESTAMP and a snake_case rename.

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.0, min 0.0 and max 1998.49; all samples carry at most two decimal places (0.04, 0.06, 1998.49), so DECIMAL(10,2) preserves the values; zero prices exist (min 0.0).

Landed as DECIMAL(38,9) with null_rate 0.29778 (13468 nulls); all samples and the min (12346.0) and max (18287.0) are integral, so a cast to INTEGER is safe, and nulls are retained as unidentified-customer transactions.
Country name with null_rate 0.0 and only 24 distinct values; samples like 'Australia' and 'EIRE' are clean text.
Airbyte capture-tool metadata (is_airbyte_metadata true); a per-record UUID with 45228 distinct values, not a business column, so it is dropped.
Airbyte capture-tool metadata (is_airbyte_metadata true); only 2 distinct extraction timestamps one second apart, carrying no business meaning, so it is dropped.
Airbyte capture-tool metadata (is_airbyte_metadata true); a single distinct value '{}' across all rows, carrying no information, so it is dropped.

decisions.rationale: The profile reports duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 over 45228 rows (roughly 506 fully identical rows); exact duplicates across all eight business columns are collapsed to one row, since identical line items on the same invoice at the same timestamp are capture artifacts.

One row per invoice line, declared as invoice + stock_code + invoice_date + quantity + price; invoice + stock_code alone is not provably unique from the profile (an invoice can repeat a product on separate lines), so quantity and price are included and the grain must be measured against the warehouse before approval.
customer_id has null_rate 0.29778 (13468 nulls); these are guest or unidentified transactions and are retained as nulls rather than imputed or dropped.
quantity has min -1395.0 and multiple negative samples, indicating return or cancellation lines; an is_return boolean flag is derived so consumers can filter them deliberately.
invoicedate landed as VARCHAR but all 10 samples are ISO-shaped timestamps like '2009-12-01 07:45:00', so a strict cast to TIMESTAMP is applied.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata true in the profile and carry no business meaning, so all three are dropped from silver.

purpose: silver_online_retail_ii is the cleaned, typed invoice-line table for the Online Retail II source: one row per invoice line with exact duplicate rows removed, columns renamed to snake_case, timestamps and numerics cast from their landed text/decimal forms, and a derived is_return flag marking negative-quantity lines. It feeds downstream sales, returns, and customer analytics.
usage: Read one row as one line item on an invoice. Filter is_return = false (quantity > 0) for sales analyses, and be aware that roughly 29.8% of rows have a null customer_id (guest or unidentified transactions), so customer-level aggregations must either exclude or separately bucket those rows. price can be 0.0 (min observed), so revenue calculations should decide how to treat zero-price lines.
limitations: Only exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 in bronze) are removed; near-duplicates differing in timestamp are not collapsed. description retains leading/trailing whitespace and 228 nulls (null_rate 0.005041) untrimmed and unimputed. customer_id nulls (null_rate 0.29778) are retained, not resolved. The declared grain of invoice + stock_code + invoice_date + quantity + price is a hypothesis from profile evidence and must be verified against the warehouse before approval.
